headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 25 points in his return from a two-game absence, leading the Houston Rockets to a 129-101 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Houston Rockets dominate Utah Jazz for fifth straight road victory

headlines.description: — Payton Pritchard scored a season-high 42 points, Jaylen Brown got his fourth career triple-double and the Boston Celtics barely held on to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 117-115 on Sunday night after giving up most of their big lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Payton Pritchard scores 42, Jaylen Brown gets triple-double as Celtics outlast Cavaliers 117-115

events.name: Toronto Raptors at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Josh Hart had 20 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists, Karl-Anthony Towns added 22 points and eight rebounds and the New York Knicks beat the Toronto Raptors 116-94 on Sunday for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks beat Raptors 116-94 for their 4th straight victory

headlines.description: — Jalen Johnson hit consecutive 3-pointers late in double overtime and finished with 41 points and 14 rebounds to help the Atlanta Hawks spoil Joel Embiid’s return in a 142-134 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson hits late 3s for Hawks to spoil Embiid's 76ers return in 142-134 double-OT win

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 26 points, Chet Holmgren had 19 points and nine rebounds, and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Portland Trail Blazers 123-115 on Sunday night for their 12th straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 26, Thunder hold on to beat Trail Blazers 123-115

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 32 points to became Minnesota's all-time leader in games with 30 or more points, Julius Randle added 22 points, 12 assists and six rebounds, and the Timberwolves pulled away from the San Antonio Spurs in the fourth quarter of...
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards sets Wolves franchise mark in 125-112 home win against Spurs

headlines.description: — Zach Edey had a career-high 32 points and 17 rebounds to help the Memphis Grizzlies hold off the Sacramento Kings 115-107 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Edey has career-high 32 points to lead Grizzlies past Kings 115-107

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic scored 20 of his 34 points in the first quarter and the Los Angeles Lakers raced to their seventh straight victory, 133-121 over the New Orleans Pelicans on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic, Lakers start fast, beat Pelicans 133-121 for 7th straight victory
